condition: VS-001A writes only executor-provenance instrumentation (Claude Code session hooks, provenance validators, deterministic tests), its own canonical Run/Session/Checkpoint/Handoff/Evidence artifacts, its own dogfood effect and evidence, and its own backlog/index records. It does not change Continuity Core semantics, does not migrate another feature family, and does not rerun or rewrite run-vs001.
rationale: Close the VS-001 executor-provenance evidence gap (acceptance criteria 4, 7, 8) without letting corrective validation become architecture expansion or unrelated Nestfolio work.
exception_policy: No automatic exception. Scope expansion requires a new explicit Scope revision and human authorization.
